_doc: S1.SH1A encoded from the Director's beat record (locked script: bizzy chant + 'Nailed it.'). Every beat-record commitment carried: two readable near-misses, squashy flower contact, elastic leaf recoil, landing breath, witness two-shot. Reference files are the production assets (signed keyframe as first frame).
purpose: Fuzzby's overconfident chase slams him through flower and leaf into a proud wobbling hover he sells as victory — the first false triumph.

foley: squashy petal impact and elastic leaf twang

references.defines: the opening composition, both bees' positions and the camera axis
references.ignore: identity, materials and any action after 0.0s

references.defines: Fuzzby's identity, proportions and scale; refer to it strictly
Zenny's identity, proportions and scale; refer to it strictly
the corridor look: palette, plants, mountains, sun direction, atmosphere
references.ignore: any characters or foreground action in it

references.defines: Fuzzby's performed chant and line with exact timing and silences
references.ignore: everything beyond it except authorised foley

geography: The corridor runs frame-left (west) to frame-right (east); Fuzzby travels west to east on a jagged centre-right route, never reversing.
Zenny holds a clean parallel line centre-left, outside his route, close enough to witness.
The open flower, then the springy leaf, wait ahead on his route.
light: Warm sun from upper frame-right catches wings, fur edges and drifting pollen.
conduct: Fuzzby plays proud authority, never distress — the crash is performed as if he meant it.
Emphasize the contrast of his big chaotic energy against her small precise stillness; increasingly intense, never random.

stages.action: Fuzzby barrels down the corridor chanting from @Audio1, threading two readable near-misses — clipping past a flower head on his left, ducking a swaying stem on his right — each dodge bigger than it needs to be
stages.cause: overconfidence running faster than his own corrections
stages.camera: follows Fuzzby slightly late at bee height; stems whip past without hiding him
stages.end_state: the open flower dead ahead, his line too steep to change

stages.action: he dives too hard into the open flower, scoops a faceful of pollen, and smears sideways off the petals into the springy leaf
stages.cause: too much speed into too soft a target
stages.sound: squashy petal impact, one pollen puff
stages.end_state: his weight lands sideways on the leaf, visibly depressing it

stages.action: the leaf bends deep, stores his momentum, then snaps back and FWIPs him through one tucked rotation into an upright hover
stages.camera: the camera settles as the recoil launches him
stages.end_state: upright chest-forward hover, wobbling, pollen drifting off him

stages.action: he snaps the wobble into a chest-forward gymnastic finish and delivers his line from @Audio1 to Zenny before his body has settled
stages.cause: chaos must read as expert competence in front of Zenny
stages.camera: locked two-shot: his pose and Zenny's level attention in frame together
stages.hold_what: the proud pose held while wobble and pollen contradict it; Zenny watches calmly
stages.end_state: Fuzzby chest-forward, pollen-dusted, unsettled; Zenny close and calm; the leaf recovering

camera_policy.policy: one bee-height travelling view follows Fuzzby slightly late, then settles into a locked two-shot for the recoil and the held button

end_state: Fuzzby hovers chest-forward, pollen drifting, still unsettled; the leaf recovers; Zenny witnesses, close and calm. Harvest this frame as S1.SH1B's opening reference.
constraints: Exactly one Fuzzby and one Zenny; no duplicates of either
Nothing damaged: petals and leaf recover, no debris
No gag after the button — once the pose lands, nothing else happens
